greeting.text: 302! Did you like the braised beef?

lines.text: A bit salty, right? My husband said so too.
Maybe stir-fried anchovies next. Do you like those?
Well, if it was tasty, that's all that matters.
Bring the container back anytime. Really, anytime.

flushRemark.text: Oh my, no need to be so shy~

closers.satisfied: So glad you liked it~ I'll make more!
closers.endured: I talked a lot. Go on in~
closers.sos: You've got a call, take it!
closers.awkward: …Well, as long as you liked it.
